concept: DynamoDB: fine-grained access via condition keys (dynamodb:Attributes)
tests: How to restrict which table attributes (fields) each microservice can read.
expected: IAM policies with dynamodb:Attributes condition keys (plus dynamodb:Select / projection) for attribute-level control. Triggers: "which fields each microservice can read", "fine-grained", PII.
why_not: KMS encryption of the whole table is at rest, not per-field authorization; Streams is change capture; a VPC endpoint is a network path.
